nodes.label: RoboGyaan Invoice Suite Documentation
nodes.description: Comprehensive architectural documentation and specifications for RoboGyaan Invoice Suite v1.5.4 covering Virgil Excalidraw typography, Neo-Brutalism design system, Deep Obsidian Dark Mode, Apache License 2.0, dual-platform architecture, Android DRAFT payment option, and yellow card contrast.

nodes.label: Responsive Split Page Resizer Specification
nodes.description: Specification for interactive vertical split divider with yellow handle box allowing dynamic 50-50, 25-75, and 75-25 split between editor and live preview.

nodes.label: Deep Obsidian Dark Mode Palette
nodes.description: Standard high-contrast dark theme palette restoring pitch black obsidian canvas and NeoBlack card title contrast on yellow cards.

nodes.label: Android Payment Method Draft Optimization
nodes.description: Android-specific payment method display label shortened to DRAFT from BANK DRAFT to maintain single-line horizontal alignment across payment chips.
